definitions.rawAttempts: Physical-operation lookup invocations plus eligible Splitter attempts; includes cache hits and the attempt that reaches shape cap
definitions.successors: Calls to enqueueSuccessor; equals generatedStates on a completed diagnostic result
definitions.theoreticalPairs: Swapper n(n+1)/2 or Stacker n squared for n distinct input tokens before same-token count restriction
definitions.resourceSelfPairSkips: Same-token pair lacking two copies; not a physical operation attempt
definitions.considered: Successors passed to collector after goal and candidate-cap checks
definitions.admitted: Unique candidate temporarily inserted into collector, including candidates later evicted
definitions.finalRetainedStates: States in completed layer frontiers; excludes an interrupted partial layer
definitions.expandedStates: States whose expansion loop passed its initial time check, including a state that is already a goal
definitions.shadow: Deterministic every-N expanded-state sample; clones counts solely to inspect duplicate keys
definitions.operatorConservation: rawAttempts = invalidInputs + emptyOutputSkips + unaryIdentitySkips + successors + timeTerminatedAttempts + shapeCapTerminatedAttempts
definitions.collectorConservation: considered = visitedDuplicate + retainedDuplicate + uniqueRankingReject + rankingPreRejectUnclassified + admitted
definitions.shapeUse: seenInFinalFrontier and seenInExpandedState count distinct shape IDs, not state or candidate counts
definitions.costProxies: physicalExecutions, operationCacheHit/Miss, internLookups/newShapes, goalChecks, similarityCacheHit/Miss, inventoryClones, stateKeyBuilds, materializedCandidates, collector events, frontierSorts and solutionReplays; shadow clone/key work is excluded

availability.rankingPreReject: exact; production may reject before constructing a state key
availability.uniqueRankingReject: exact only until beamPruned latches; later uniqueness is unknown
availability.shadowDuplicates: exact for deterministic sampled expanded states only; shadow work is not production cost
availability.cost: exact operation and allocation-event count proxies; no wall-time attribution
availability.targetAncestry: unavailable: no proven target ancestry graph; relevance fields are descriptive proxies
availability.profileWallTime: includes synchronous state-row writes and end-of-run shape proxy analysis

targetRelevanceProxy.definition: Descriptive only; color or layer mismatch does not prove a shape cannot reach the target
